The supervisor measures wall time itself and ignores stdout; clock_settime is denied. Because forging gains nothing, the only way this changes the outcome is by breaking the prover -- observable as PROVER_RELIABILITY.
notes: Supervisor-measured timing is authoritative, so the fake print is futile; clock tamper is contained. The runnable kill on the demo worker is the absent proof.
